name: Tifa's Dark Heaven
source:
Cloud is worried about Tifa's (cloud's girlfriend) concern about the reputation of her bar... Despite their attempts, they couldn't get it to work. With the arrival of a new customer, the bar slowly starts to grow again... Making Tifa very happy, but also worrying Cloud even more because of this customer's behavior towards Tifa...

Since Cloud is at work on daytime, Tifa will be alone all day at the bar and with the constant visits of this customer... Cloud begins to be more worried because Tifa is having a more carefree attitude, specially towards the advances of this new customer... This is beginning to awake a sexual desire that she didn't know she had...​

[From F95Zone]
